items.title: Bengal & Assam fixes Sept 1 record date for ₹50 dividend
items.summary: Bengal & Assam Company Limited announced a record date of September 1, 2026, for its proposed ₹50 per share dividend, subject to AGM approval on September 8, 2026. The company complied with SEBI LODR Regulations by notifying BSE and publishing advertisements in Financial Express and Aajkal.
